changelog:
- Initial release of the agent-interaction skill, providing a full Agent workflow based on the "three-step confirmation link" (natural language → form highlight → confirmation submission) and implicit validation.
- Dramatically compresses traditional 6-step IM flows into a more efficient 3-step Copilot experience, reducing user effort.
- Includes detailed design principles, gate-based execution phases, and a robust interaction state machine covering all user actions.
- Introduces structured confirmation cards, three-color highlighting for user/Ai changes, and multiple implicit validation layers.
- Adds context-aware quick action buttons and template systems for efficiency, strictly using front-end rules instead of LLM-generated controls.
- Incorporates multi-user collaboration awareness and best practices to avoid common pitfalls in Agent interaction design.
summary: Agent 交互链路 skill。基于 One Click 的"三步确认链路"(自然语言→填表高亮→确认提交)+ 隐式校验层,设计 Agent 的完整交互流程。触发场景:用户说"交互设计"、"Agent 流程"、"Copilot 交互"、或 workflow-start 路由到此 skill。
